name: manual_ae8bbf
claim: Parallel subagents each need their own git worktree (a worktree has one HEAD, so two agents running git checkout -b in one directory collide). Give each a disjoint file set and a frozen interface contract in both prompts, then integrate and verify yourself: read security-sensitive code line by line and re-run the combined suite instead of trusting self-reports. Verify a subagent's reported blocker directly before relaying it.

decisions.notes: oramasys#63, 2026-10-18: I first told one agent to branch inside a directory the second would also use, caught it before dispatch, and created a separate worktree. The split (pure digest module versus permit lifecycle against a frozen import contract) integrated cleanly. Review of the integrated code found the digest-encoding defect that neither self-report mentioned. A different subagent reported 'BLOCKED: worktree is not a git repository' from a stale environment banner; checking the worktree directly (git status exit 0, correct branch) showed a false alarm and the retry succeeded.
